history.text: During the founding of the Empire, Bastion very nearly became the "official" capital of the Empire in 3YE; at the last minute the Senate decided to hold their quarterly gatherings in Anvil instead.
Semmerholm became part of the Empire in 52YE during the reign of Empress Richilde, following a protracted campaign against a nation of especially vicious barbarian orcs.
Long after peace settled over Bastion and newly-christened Necropolis, Casinea remained tumultuous right up until the Foundation of the Empire and the final conquest of Reikos in 56YE.
While Reikos was only conquered in 56YE, the Highborn had established settlements along its southern borders long before the foundation of the Empire.
Proud of its independence, Holberg eventually joined the League in 136YE under a riot of political strife in the Senate.
Even after the eastern regions were conquered, bands of scattered orcs remained to harass settlers - indeed there are reports of orc raiders attacking into Casfall and Syrwatch as late as 150YE.
In 241YE, during the reign of Emperor Guntherm, parts of Verthandi were conquered by a combined force from Varushka and Dawn.
Their occupation was short lived - in 243YE they were forced to retreat back across the mountains, pursued by a counter-invasion force of Thule orcs that laid siege to Skarsind and Karsk.
The occupation did not last - when the famous ceasefire with the Jotun ended in 248YE, the would-be settlers retreated back into Bregasland and the Jotun ultimately captured the Nail.
Between 325YE and 328YE it was also the scene of a short-lived rogue kingdom called Montane, founded by renegades during the events of the Freedom Heresy.
The armies that invaded Spiral in 331YE came north through Mareave, through the Apulian Gate that is the only reliable way to move large numbers of troops between the Broken Shore and the Empire.
Since 331YE and the barbarian conquest of Spiral, Redoubt has been preparing itself for invasion.
Sarvos was the birth-place of the Empress Giselle, who held the Throne between 331YE and 346YE.

In 331YE, barbarians from the Broken Shore came up through Apulus along the coast, and with weapons fashioned from the glass taken from the Black Plateau overran the defenders of Spiral, resisting all efforts to throw them back.
In 346YE, however, barbarians attacked the territory, sacked the vineyards, burnt the hardwood groves so precious to the city's crossbow makers, and laid siege to the walled city.
The Jotun launched the first invasion of recent times during the Autumn of 346YE, taking advantage of the fact that Empress Giselle had focused the Imperial armies in the east, fighting the Druj.
Immediately after the fall of Holberg in 346YE, coupled with renewed barbarian activity in The Barrens, many Dawnish Earls were convinced a major offensive against Semmerholm was in the offing.
In 348YE, the city was struck by a terrible tempest that did significant damage to many coastal parts of the city and led to the flooding and eventual sinking of the southern district of Caricomare.
The Empire finally lost control of Liathaven in early 349YE despite attempts by the Military Council to organise a proper counter-offensive.

In the thirty years after the forests fell to the orcs, the used their foothold in Liathaven to launch regular raids into Bregasland and Kahraman, and as a staging post for their massed assault against the Mournwold in 349YE.

The peace of Segura came to an abrupt end in 363YE when a great force of barbarians moved in from the west and took Anduz, scattering the foreigners and the Freeborn and burning much of the grassland.
As with Bastion, Casinea saw an influx of refugees from beleaguered Reikos when it fell to the orcs in 367YE.
All of this changed in 367YE with the arrival of the Druj.
When the Druj barbarians launched a surprise attack through the forest in 367YE, the Highborn were woefully unprepared for it.
When Burnish fell to the barbarians in 367YE, nobody outside the Brass Coast seemed to notice or care.
Since the fall of Reikos in 367YE, many Navarr had been expecting an assault from the barbarians.
After a period of escalating raids, barbarian orcs invaded Karsk from the north in 368YE.
Following the Thule invasion of Karsk in 368YE, probing assaults were made against Livardz and Suvretz.
In the Winter of 370YE the Jotun invaded in force, taking West Marsh and pushing into Skymark.
In the Winter of 370YE the Jotun invaded in force, taking Stark and Tanikipari.

In 372YE the Thule attempted to push through Malimorzi and briefly occupied the settlement of Korotny, but they were driven back within a season by the combined forces of the Northern Eagle and Golden Axe.
The last such attack in 372YE saw significant losses on both sides, and several new Jotun burial mounds along the southern borders.
The fall of Skarsind in 373YE left the people of Hercynia facing immediate danger, as the Thule orcs tried to force their way into the forest to achieve the capture of the whole of the Great Vale.
This changed in 373YE when a major offensive against the city was revealed to be a feint to allow four Druj armies to push through into Semmerholm.
With their eyes focused on the western and eastern borders, however, the Empire was unprepared for the invasion of Skarsind in 373YE.
In 373YE a savage blizzard swept down out of the mountains.
